enable_plperl.description: Enable PL/Perl as a shared preload library so it's available across sessions.

enable_plperlu.description: Enable PL/PerlU (untrusted) — allows system calls and file access. Disable unless explicitly needed for security reasons.

plperl_on_init.description: SQL command(s) executed once per Perl interpreter initialization (e.g., `use strict;` or `use warnings;`). Leave blank for default.

plperl_on_plperl_init.description: SQL command(s) executed every time a new PL/Perl function is loaded in the session. Useful for session-scoped setup.

plperl_max_mem.description: Maximum memory (in KB) a single PL/Perl function can allocate during execution. 0 = no limit. Use to prevent runaway scripts.

plperl_inc_paths.description: Additional paths to prepend to Perl’s @INC (module search path) for PL/Perl functions.

items.description: A filesystem path to add to Perl’s module include path.

plperl_version.description: Explicit PL/Perl version (e.g., '5.38'). Usually auto-detected — only set if override is needed.
